probe: ADR-0094 P1 — Sonnet 5 as the planner
rule_written_first: Changes the plan if Sonnet's plan validates with a comparable task count and ≤ half the dollars — then L4 plans by default (ADR-0094, written before the run).

sonnet_void_first_run.why: at its 5th tool call it read the Opus arm's finished plan for the same job (10k chars) from the shared plans folder; everything after was verifying an answer key
sonnet_void_first_run.use: evidence for P2 (a cheaper model checking a plan it is handed), not for P1

sonnet_clean_run.isolation: all other plans moved out of the folder for the run; the prompt forbade reading other plans and run directories; the transcript was audited — no forbidden read
sonnet_clean_run.reader_note: one read batch returned 6 admitted claims its own check of the cited lines found false — the 7B reader's overstatement, again

verdict: NOT MET — 81 % of Opus's dollars (not ≤ 50 %), 7 tasks against 11 (not comparable), and more expensive per task. Sonnet is ~2× cheaper per token and used more of them, dominated by cache reads. L4 does not plan by default; the planner stays the user's model, and P2 (two-level) is the next probe of the middle tier.
